title: The Mummy Downstairs | Animated Horror Story
description: A museum sarcophagus is delivered to the wrong address: Jeff's house. It stays in the basement, chained shut, for one night. Then two. An original animated horror story.

cast.omni: male, middle-aged, low pitch, american accent
male, elderly, low pitch, british accent

beats.line: Dad… why is there a coffin in our house?
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: A sarcophagus. And it's supposed to be at the museum.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: Please tell me this is going straight back on the truck.
beats.speaker: mom

beats.line: They've used my home address instead of the museum's receiving entrance.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: Dispatch says the collection team can return tomorrow afternoon.
beats.speaker: worker

beats.line: Maybe he wanted to meet the family.
beats.speaker: kim

beats.line: We'll keep it downstairs until they collect it. Everyone leaves the case alone.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: Touch the case. One finger. Then I'll stop teasing you about it.
beats.speaker: kim

beats.line: Dad said to leave it alone.
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: He meant opening it. You can touch the outside.
beats.speaker: kim

beats.line: If you turn the light off—
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: You wanted me to stay here. I'm staying here.
beats.speaker: kim

beats.line: Open it! Open it right now!
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: The chains were shaking. I saw it.
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: Something moved in that case. Kim keeps saying it didn't, but I saw it.
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: You had a frightening evening. Sometimes every little noise sounds different after that.
beats.speaker: mom

beats.line: I'll leave your door open. And the hallway light can stay on.
beats.speaker: mom

beats.line: Do you have anything that could stop a mummy?
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: There's a legend about this powder. Says a mummy loses its strength when it touches it.
beats.speaker: owner

beats.line: I've had very few mummies come through the door.
beats.speaker: owner

beats.line: Do I throw all of it?
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: A pinch should be enough, according to the booklet.
beats.speaker: owner

beats.line: The collection has been delayed until tomorrow morning.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: One more. Then it's going straight into secure storage.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: I know how to stop you.
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: It was here! You saw it!
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: What happens if they come off?
beats.speaker: hero

beats.line: There was a story in the records that came with the case. A warning that the mummy would wake if the chains were removed.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: I thought it was an old superstition.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: Stay away from this door. I'm calling the museum.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: I'm sorry. I should have arranged somewhere else to keep it.
beats.speaker: dad

beats.line: And I'm sorry I didn't listen to you last night.
beats.speaker: mom

beats.line: What did you throw at me?
beats.speaker: kim

beats.line: Dad, it's me. Open the door.
beats.speaker: kim
